title: PIXL 8000 Fresh Mint Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Fresh Mint from PIXL 8000 delivers a clean, breezy Mint flavour that’s cool without being overpowering. Perfect for vapers who enjoy an uplifting, menthol-style vape with a bright finish. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is supplied with a 10ml refill reservoir. Compatible with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup offers up to 8000 puffs with mesh coil technology for smooth, reliable flavour throughout. Designed for MTL vaping, this draw-activated pod is quick to install and effortless to use. Boost Mode is available for bigger clouds on demand. Fresh Mint is one of the most popular menthol-inspired options in the PIXL collection.
